concepts.name: Коммутационная панель
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity desktop website SECTION concept that continues the supplied approved Vault 443 hero. Input image is MATERIAL AND CRAFT reference only, not a layout to duplicate. Match its exceptionally detailed original 1997–1998 Fallout 1/2 inspired prerendered industrial UI: dense contiguous worn graphite steel, thick cast frames, aged golden brass edges, screws, oxidized seams, protected green lamps, deep recesses, believable scratches, warm ivory condensed lettering, green CRT glass. Front-on orthographic finished interface filling a wide 1536×1024 canvas, no perspective room or device mockup, no browser chrome. One coherent machinery assembly, not generic modern cards. Compose actual usable web controls with generous text sizes, clear hierarchy and readable Russian. No new Vault 443 branding or painted 443; reserve product name to the existing hero, outside this section. No vault door, circular hatch or moving gate in these concepts. Content works as static GitHub Pages HTML/CSS/SVG with animated route illumination added later. Clearly mark the route display “ДЕМОНСТРАЦИЯ”, never imply a real active VPN. Display exactly these concepts: local device → VPN client → internet, work network, Docker network. Three scenario controls “Интернет”, “Интернет + работа”, “Работа и Docker”. Main heading exact Russian: “Каждому подключению — свой путь.” Subtitle “Интернет, работа и Docker на одном компьютере.” A distinct physical action “Запустить демо”. Bottom short readout “Готово к запуску”. Keep all labels as part of readable plates. No QR codes, no analytics widgets, no made-up performance claims.
Specific composition: A heavy analog patchboard routing console. Left column has three broad recessed scenario keys with mechanical interlock and one brass run lever. On the right, five substantial connection modules with engraved device/network icons, circular jack sockets and readable labels. Real thick copper/black patch cables travel through machined grooves and form a clear branching routing diagram. Green lamps light along one selected path; inactive cables are dark, optional work and Docker paths remain legible. Physical patch wiring is the hero of the composition, framed by densely detailed thick steel side rails and ventilation, with a narrow green status glass strip below. Avoid a huge generic computer monitor: this is a tactile switchboard.

concepts.name: Архивный терминал
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing. Produce one finished high fidelity desktop WEBSITE SECTION concept for the screenshot gallery below the approved Vault 443 hero. Input 1 is the exact MATERIAL/CRAFT reference only. Other input images are REAL application screenshots to insert as content, unchanged and at native proportions, not to redesign. Dense original early Fallout 1 & 2 inspired machinery like input 1: heavily detailed worn graphite steel, aged brass, small rusty scratches, deep rectangular recesses, thick frames, protected green lamps, vents, rivets, condensed ivory lettering. Front-on 1536×1024 single wide section, no browser chrome, no photographed computer or perspective room. Fill the composition with one integrated equipment chassis and exceptionally realistic material detail. Avoid generic modern cards and flat CSS-looking borders. Main heading verbatim “Загляните внутрь пульта.” Short subtitle “Настоящие скриншоты приложения в деморежиме.” Six actual screenshot categories: “Импорт”, “Настройки”, “Рабочие VPN”, “Маршруты”, “Журналы”, “Узлы”. Clear controls “Увеличить”, previous and next. Caption “Проверьте импортируемые профили перед сохранением.” Do not add any new Vault 443 titles, logos or 443 markings outside the supplied screenshots. ABSOLUTELY NO vault door, circular hatch, gates, leaves, hinges, curtains or sliding shutters. The application screenshot is always exposed in a fixed RECTANGULAR viewing area. Future interaction only changes the picture with a brief CRT shimmer or crossfade, not an opening mechanism. Keep readable labels and generous controls suitable for static HTML/CSS/SVG GitHub Pages implementation.
Specific composition: A deep, rugged archive terminal built into the same bunker wall. Left one-quarter: a vertical rack of six large brass-edged pushplates with category names, tiny category icons and one selected green lamp. Right three-quarters: a huge fixed rectangular steel viewing frame with the REAL supplied import screenshot centered prominently at its correct near-square aspect ratio on matte CRT glass; enough space to inspect the real UI without squeezing it. Thick machined bezel, top glass DEMO indicator, bottom descriptive caption and a broad brass Enlarge button flanked by previous/next keys. Physical rivets, protective rails and side vents join navigation and viewport as one continuous casting. The main screenshot should be the dominant focal point.

concepts.name: Шкаф установочных комплектов
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Draw one high fidelity desktop WEBSITE SECTION for downloading the Vault 443 Linux client, matching the supplied approved hero as a MATERIAL/CRAFT reference. Same densely detailed original early Fallout 1 & 2 prerendered metal interface: worn graphite steel, thick brass beveled plates, realistic scratches, screws, inset lettering, deep shadows, small green lamps, vents and coherent attached hardware. A front-on 1536×1024 finished web section, no browser chrome, no room perspective. This is a single connected physical apparatus, not a modern flat card grid. Main heading exact “Выберите систему. Возьмите управление.” Show a clear version strip “ВЕРСИЯ 1.3.4 • LINUX x86-64”. Exactly FOUR installer choices, all their download buttons immediately visible: “Ubuntu 24.04 / 26.04” with “.deb”, “Debian 13” with “.deb”, “Fedora 44” with “.rpm”, “Arch Linux” with “.pkg.tar.zst”. Fedora and Arch each carry an understated “Первоначальный порт” marker. Each distribution has its own large tactile “СКАЧАТЬ” key, smaller “SHA-256” link and “Команды установки” action. Distro symbols/emblems in embossed brass, retain readable distro names; Ubuntu orange, Debian red, Fedora blue, Arch cyan may be subtle badge accents while the overall palette stays steel/brass/green. Bottom supporting line “Сначала проверьте контрольную сумму.” and link “Все файлы релиза”. Do not invent Windows/macOS/mobile builds or servers, no account/registration. Do not add new Vault 443 mastheads, logos or huge 443 numbers. Never add a vault door or opening shutters. All text/buttons/sums/commands will be native accessible HTML on static GitHub Pages, so provide real readable control space, not ornamental fake tiny labels.
Specific composition: A two-by-two arrangement of FOUR massive equipment compartments within one cast steel cabinet. Each bay has its distribution emblem stamped into a chunky left-hand metal badge, a wide engraved nameplate, package type and subtle support status; a substantial brass download pushplate and checksum/install key row below. The bays are joined by one central steel cross beam, machined rails and common outer plumbing; large green cage lamps bracket the cabinet. Ubuntu/Debian top row, Fedora/Arch bottom row. Keep the nameplates for Ubuntu versions spacious, all four download keys clearly prominent. Dense physical depth and connected framing like the approved hero, with no floating modern cards.
